newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine farmers win tax concessions.
newsitem.headline: Argentine farmers win tax concessions.

text.p: Argentina's farmers have won key concessions from Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, who has promised them exemptions from tax rises planned in a major austerity package, local media reported Wednesday.

Fernandez promised farm leaders in a meeting Tuesday that they will be able to discount from income tax 100 percent of a big tax rise on diesel fuel and that he will ask Congress to excuse them from a proposed doubling on wealth tax.
Originally, farmers were only going to be able to deduct 50 percent of the rise in diesel from income tax.
Farmers had argued that the measures would hit more heavily-indebted producers but most analysts considered that even if they had had to pay the higher taxes it would not have affected output.
